id.description: PART 12 §41: the sidecar's own name for one input, unique within a sidecar and referenced by a node's source.

uri.description: PART 12 §41: where the input came from. The sidecar is where a filesystem path may appear; pos.file stays the inline minimum per §13.

format.description: PART 12 §41: the input's format where it was not Carve. ABSENT means unrecorded, never a guessed Carve.

parent.description: PART 12 §41: the id of the source that included or imported this one. Absent on a root input; walking it reaches the root.

path.description: PART 12 §41: RFC 6901 pointer into the accompanying canonical AST, as in §38. Unique within a sidecar.

source.description: PART 12 §41: the id of the sources entry this node came from.

startByte.description: PART 12 §41: start of the node's bytes IN THAT INPUT, as in §13 and not in the assembled document. Not an offset, which §4 counts in codepoints.

endByte.description: PART 12 §41: end of the node's bytes in that input, exclusive.

origin.description: PART 12 §41: whether a person wrote the node or the processor produced it.

step.description: PART 12 §41: opaque id of the transformation that produced the node. Core never reads it.
